name: Katherine Tseng
title: Board Vice President, Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District
years_of_service: Appointed in lieu of election to the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District Board of Trustees in 2024; current term expires 2028, per the district's board directory.
background: Tseng has been involved in Los Gatos-Saratoga school community activities for 14 years, per the district's board directory, prior to joining the Board of Trustees. She held leadership roles including Co-President of the Saratoga High School Foundation and Music Boosters, and served on the Executive Board of Sports Boosters.

She contributed to district governance for six years through the Saratoga Union School District Advisory Board and the Superintendent's Advisory Council. She co-chaired the successful campaign for the district's Measure A parcel tax. Her professional credentials include an MA in Statistics and 15 years of actuarial consulting experience. She is a parent to two Saratoga High School graduates.

As Board Vice President, she is listed as a co-sponsor of Measure N, a $321,000,000 facilities bond covering Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School, placed on the November 3, 2026 ballot; full detail on that measure is covered in content/measures/scc-measure-n-2026.json and not duplicated here.
attendance: No individually published meeting-attendance or voting-participation record for Vice President Tseng was found. Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District does not appear to publish a per-trustee attendance scorecard on its public board pages; board agendas and minutes are posted but were not tallied individually within this session's tool budget.
